homework.title: Homework help
homework.body: I'll give you hints – you'll find the answer yourself.

vocab.title: Test my vocab
vocab.body: I'll test you in both directions.

practice.title: What do you want to practise?
practice.hint: I'll ask you a few questions about it.

test.title: What is the test about?
test.hint: One answer per question, no hints – you'll see the result at the end.
test.placeholder: e.g. fractions, unit 3, the Middle Ages

vocab.title: Type in your vocab
vocab.hint: One pair per line. I'll test you in both directions.
vocab.placeholder:
la chambre – the bedroom
le lit – the bed

speak.title: What do you want to practise saying?
speak.hint: I'll listen and tell you what already sounds good.
speak.placeholder: e.g. Unit 3 or your own sentences

listen.title: What should the text be about?
listen.hint: I read you a short text and ask you about it.
listen.placeholder: e.g. English Unit 3, holidays in French

help.title: Which task? Copy it here.
help.hint: I'll give you hints – you'll find the answer yourself.

topic.example_hint: Puts the example into the field.
topic.not_usable: I can't prepare anything from that, sorry – try a school topic.

rehearse.gone: This recording is no longer there. Just ask Buddy again.
rehearse.intro_talk: “{{title}}” – give it the way you will in class.
rehearse.intro_talk_minutes: “{{title}}” · {{minutes}} minutes. Give it the way you will in class.
rehearse.intro_read: Read the text aloud, take your time.
rehearse.measure_pace: How fast you speak – and how often you say “um”
rehearse.measure_parts: Whether there is an opening, a main part and an ending
rehearse.hint_read: Tap the mic and start reading.
rehearse.recording_talk: I’m listening. Tap stop when you’re done.
rehearse.recording_read: I’m listening. Tap stop when you’re done.

problem.no_speech: I didn’t hear anything. Try again, a little closer to the mic.
problem.too_short: That was very short. Tap the mic and just start talking.
problem.denied: I’m not allowed to use the microphone. You can allow it in settings.
problem.failed: I couldn’t listen just now. Try again in a moment.
problem.offline: No connection. Your recording is still here.

rehearse.done_talk: Here’s what I measured. Tell Buddy how it felt.
rehearse.length_fits: Right on the length you were given.
rehearse.pace_note_read: Counting the words you read correctly.
rehearse.fillers_note: “Um” and “uh” – a short pause often sounds calmer.
rehearse.words_none: No word left out – you read it all.
